metadata.dcterms:title: FROM STATE INTEGRALS TO q-SERIES
metadata.dcterms:creator: GAROUFALIDIS, STAVROS
KASHAEV, RINAT
metadata.dcterms:abstract: It is well-known to the experts that multi-dimensional state integrals of prod- ucts of Faddeev’s quantum dilogarithm which arise in Quantum Topology can be written as ﬁnite sums of products of basic hypergeometric series in q = e2πiτ and ˜q = e−2πi/τ. We illustrate this fact by giving a detailed proof for a family of one-dimensional integrals which includes state-integral invariants of 41 and 52 knots.
